The main takeaway from our work is that
the amplification of oscillations is not limited to a particular type of disk deformation.
the resonance condition is determined by the frequency and the radial location of the deformation and not by its azimuthal structure.
the amplification of the disk oscillations resulting form resonant couplings with the deformation is a generic phenomenon.
